subject: general
question: What is the traditional language used in Bhaona which was created by Sankardeva?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brajawali.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brajavali **is the language used by **Srimanta Sankardeva**, **Madhabdev** and other composers who belonged to the religious sect started by Srimanta Sankardeva in the **15th-16th century in Assam.**
 
• It was used by sankerdeva in his compositions like** Borgeets, Bhaona and Ankia Naats.**
 
• **Assamese polymath** Srimanta Sankardev was a significant person in the **social and religious history of Assam**, India, as well as **a saint-scholar, poet, playwright, dancer, actor, musician, and artist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Malayalam:**

 
 
• The Malayali people speak Malayalam, a **Dravidian language,** in the Indian state of** Kerala** and the **union territories of Lakshadweep and Puducherry.**
 
• In **2013**, Malayalam received the designation **"Classical Language of India.**"
 
 
 
• **Sanskrit:**
 
 
• The **Rigveda,** the first book in the world, was first written in **Sanskrit**, an ancient and classical language of India.
 
• It is a** traditional language** of South Asia and is a part of the** Indo-Aryan group of Indo-European languages**.
 
 
 
• **Tamil:**
 
 
• The Tamil people of the Indian subcontinent are native speakers of Tamil, a **classical Dravidian language.**
 
• The sovereign states of **Singapore, Sri Lanka, and Tamil Nadu** in India as well as the Indian Union Territory of** Puducherry **all have it as one of their official languages.
